source_title: Gumroad Vs Stan Store Why I Switched

snippets.snippet_text: "After a while, I realized I needed more than just a digital shelf. Because that is what my Gumroad Store felt like it had become. What I needed a digital roadmap for specific products that people actually care about."

intake_notes: Substack article (July 9, 2025). Individual creator describing Gumroad as a passive "digital shelf" with limited product discoverability/navigation; switched to Stan Store for better product presentation.
possible_subjects: Gumroad: described as a passive 'digital shelf' with limited discoverability/navigation for buyers
